title: 1976-09-15_Dorothy_182.txt
concise_summary: PKD theorizes that his 1974 visions and his novel 'Tears' form a unified kerygmatic (proclamatory) testimony. He proposes a double-arc model where Rome AD 45 and USA 1974 are coterminous in a 'laminated reality,' with time as an abolishable ontological category. Drawing on Will Durant, he critiques Paul for transforming Christ's earthly Parousia into a post-mortem hope, whereas PKD's lived experience contradicts this: his encounter with Zebra constitutes proof that the age of the Holy Spirit has broken into history now.
key_claims: **Double-Arc Model**: The intersection of two spacetime continua (A.D. 70 and 1974) forms a "laminated" reality. Linear time is abolished, revealing the presence of the Last Days.

**Critique of Paul**: Citing Will Durant, PKD argues that Paul "saved" Christianity by transforming the expectation of Christ's *earthly* return into a hope for union *after death*. PKD's own experience contradicts this by being an in-life encounter.

**The 2000-Year Hoax**: History is a "spurious interpolation" or "hoax" of guilt and sin shot as die-messages from the BIP. Pentecost is currently occurring; we have been "rolled back" to the time of the disciples.
**Esoteric Doctrine**: PKD believes he has stumbled onto the "Gospel of the Holy Spirit"—an esoteric secret known to a small, real Christian underground for 2,000 years.
recurring_concepts: **Koinos (Shared) Hallucination**: The "group hallucination" of the world we perceive.
**Hysteresis**: A delay in the lifting of the "evil negative hallucination."
**GABA-blocked Metacircuits**: Biological constraints on the perception of reality.
**Twice-Born**: Those who have had their perception circuits disinhibited (anamnesis).
